name: department-store
description: Cloud billing, purchase entry and stock management for department-store branches

scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @ds/backend
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @ds/frontend
scripts.setup:client: npm run build:packages && npm run setup:client -w @ds/backend --
scripts.reset-password: npm run build:packages && npm run reset-password -w @ds/backend --
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @ds/backend && npm run build -w @ds/frontend
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run check-types && npm run check:i18n && npm test
scripts.check-types: npm run build:packages && npm run check-types --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:packages && npm run db:seed -w @ds/backend
